articleTitle: Airplane Flight Phase Identification Using Maximum Posterior Probability Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The flight of a civil airplane is supported by many different systems. However, during the flight pilots require different navigation and surveillance data to perform airplane guidance. Each flight phase requires the usage of different methods of guidance and maintaining a preplanned trajectory. Automatic flight phase identification is an important component of on-board data processing and in the ground surveillance data processing unit. In the paper we study plight phase identification using a probability-based approach. Flight phase is detected by vertical speed and current barometrical altitude by method of the maximum posterior probability. A normal probability density function is used as a conditional function due to the assumption of normal error distribution of barometrical sensor. The proposed approach has been verified with real traffic surveillance data obtained under automatic dependent surveillance-broadcast communication channel within Ukrainian airspace. Classification on four common flight phases of taxing, take-off, en-route, and landing is used. The proposed method guarantees flight phase recognition with a minimum risk of false detection and indicates well detection in case of gaps in data sets.

articleTitle: Estimates for Harmonic Operators in Modeling Application Processes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The report investigates the mathematical apparatus of harmonic operators, which can be used for modeling the processing of the amplitude-frequency spectrum of dynamic objects. The proposed results can be used for field modeling of relevant real objects that allow for appropriate interpretation. It is shown that for a harmonic operator represented by a Poisson operator the deviation in the spectrum of signals from the main signal will not exceed $\beta\text{ln}\displaystyle \frac{1}{\beta}$.. For the case when the biharmonic Poisson integral is represented as a harmonic operator, the deviation in the spectrum of signals from the main signal will not exceed $\beta$. The results of the study allow the use of the apparatus of harmonic operators to model applied problems, which are reduced to problems based on the Fourier transform apparatus in the processing of streaming data

articleTitle: Intelligent Automated Eddy Current System for Monitoring the Aircraft Structure Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: It is known that in the process of operation the materials of aircraft construction are exposed to significant mechanical loads and temperature changes (fluctuations) for a very short period of time. All this leads to various defects and damages to aircraft assemblies and units which need to be inspected for the safe operation of the aircraft, their assemblies, and units. In some cases, the implementation of inspection or diagnostic is accompanied by technical difficulties caused by the large size of-aircraft assemblies or units and limited access to their local places. In such conditions, it becomes especially important to provide the possibility of diagnostics in hard-to-reach places of the object.The problem can be solved by applying wireless technologies to transmit signals from the probes to the data processing units. This allows separating the probes unit and the analysis and decision-making unit in space, and simplifies the practical implementation of robotics scanning the surfaces of large assemblies and elements in hard-to-reach places.The article describes the developed intelligent wireless system for eddy current inspection of aircraft structural materials. A technique for processing and visualization information is proposed that can be used in inspection systems and intelligent decision-making when monitoring the state of large objects. The experimental results of scanning an object are presented as a distribution of the informative parameters values of the probing signal (amplitude, frequency and decrement) over the coordinates of the object.

articleTitle: On Some Applications of the Orthogonal Systems of Functions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: When developing automatic signal processing systems, it is important to determine a set of parameters in order to optimize them and increase their efficiency. In the paper the modified Fourier transformation methods for digital signal processing have been used. A new approach to the construction of special polynomials has been offered by means of which the summing function is realized. The matrix methods of summation with rectangular matrices and their efficiency in comparison with the methods based on the use of triangular matrices have been investigated. Necessary and sufficient conditions for uniform convergence of the constructed trigonometric series for any continuous function on a segment in terms of a system of numerical coefficients have been established. The Lebesgue convergence of the constructed series for any summable periodic function has been studied. The obtained results can be used in digital signal processing systems based on the use of Fourier transformations.

articleTitle: Quality and Security of Life: A Cross-Country Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: An analysis of sustainable development processes for countries of the world in the context of quality and security of human life using sustainable development gauging metrics in the space of three dimensions is performed. Leading and outsider countries by sustainable development index value are identified as well as positions of G7, the BRICS, and the MINT countries are analyzed. 2005-2020 trends of sustainable development index and its components for some countries are presented. The results of clusterization for a large group of the world countries by the values of quality of and security of human life components are proposed.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a Two Cascade Neural Network for Time Series Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The paper suggests the method for the synthesis of a two-cascade neural network for time series forecasting. The first cascade contains the basic (popular) time series forecast models with the optimal parameters for the given forecast step that allow the implementation in neural basis. The first cascade includes the basic models from the given system of models that are important for the improvement of the forecast quality. Each model of the first cascade of the neural network determines one coordinate of the weight vector of the neural element of the second cascade that is found as a result of their joint learning.

articleTitle: Neural Network Model for Monitoring of Landfills Using Remote Sensing Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The stockpiling and retention of waste is an actual problem for Ukraine today. Count of illegal dumps increases every day because many landfills are full. Special services of waste monitoring provide only partial information about the current state of waste dumps all over the country. They can’t analyse landfills’ size information and their changes over time. Authors create an efficient algorithm for waste monitoring that uses historical and actual satellite data. It provides information about the current area of landfills and makes it possible to analyse changes in landfills over time. The authors found success resolving the main problem of separating landfills from a quarry and artificial objects. This solution is based on mixed using pixel-based and object-based classification.

articleTitle: Modeling of Complex Systems Instability under Risks and Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: An approach is proposed to study the relationship between water, food and energy resources, supply chains, social and medico-epidemiological spheres based on the multi-sectoral Lorenz model. The model combines in a one framework similarly described sectors of the economy, each of which is considered in terms of the level of productivity, the number of jobs and the level of structural disruptions. As a result of modeling the conditions of occurrence of deterministic chaos has been defined, and trajectories of change of social and economic factors which allow to reduce number of structural disturbances has been calculated. This is achieved by changing the ratio of supply and demand for jobs and products. Numerical study of the model has been allowed us to analyze how changes in the balance of supply and demand in interconnected systems lead to a chaotic stable attractor. It has been considered how the sequential transition of interconnected sectors to the mode of deterministic chaos is reflected in the integrated mode of operation when there is a kind of phase synchronization of self-oscillations of six connected generators.

articleTitle: The Energy Independence of the European Countries: Consequences of the Russia’s Military Invasion of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The research presents an analysis of the problems of energy independence and energy supply of European countries given the impact of Russia's full-scale military invasion of Ukraine. This analysis is based on the Energy Freedom Index (Ief) developed by the authors. Measures aimed at increasing the level of energy independence of European countries and Ukraine were analyzed. As the main measures were proposed diversification of supplies and accelerated transition to clean energy. European countries have been clustered according to the level of economic and security losses due to the embargo on Russian energy resources. Four groups of countries have been identified in terms of their readiness to replace Russian energy resources and impose embargoes. The dynamics of the indicators of the energy freedom index, and their dependence on Russian imports were analyzed and measures to reduce this dependence were proposed.

articleTitle: Method of Static Synthesis of Aperture in Tasks of Remote Sensing and Non-Destructive Testing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Using the phenomenological approach, the concept of a coherent image of a surface that is based on the diffraction theory, Kirchhoff and Rayleigh-Sommerfeld theorems, and Huygens-Fresnel principle is defined. The basic operations of restoration of primary coherent images and possibilities of increasing their spatial resolutions in synthetic aperture radars are shown. The structure of coherent image in static synthesis of aperture in the Fraunhofer zone with telescopic view is determined. The resolution of the statistical aperture synthesis method in surface observation along the trajectory of cross form is studied.

articleTitle: Modeling of Potential Flooding Zones with Geomatics Tools
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The article presents an integrated approach that allows identifying potential flood zones using classical methods of geomatics and deep machine learning methods. Approaches to the use of remote sensing data are considered, which are especially relevant for use during the war. As a result, a model of the flooding of the territory near the city of Kyiv is presented, which was validated on the basis of satellite data of the flooded territories as a result of the dam explosion in early spring 2022.

articleTitle: Horizontal Method Application to Multiobjective Combinatorial Optimization over Permutations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The article considers multiobjective combinatorial problems on a general configuration of permutations. As is known, combinatorial optimization problems arise in many areas and are associated with solving complex problems. These problems are usually relatively easy to formulate mathematically, but most are computationally complex and require a systematic approach to solve them. The solution to such problems becomes more complicated if two or more objective functions appear in the problem statement, which can characterize different statistical and economic performance indicators. A horizontal method (HM) is proposed for solving multiobjective combinatorial problems on a general set of permutations. The main idea of this method is to use the properties of combinatorial configurations and polytopes of these configurations. The proposed method reduces the search area to solving auxiliary unbounded combinatorial problems and cuts off a part of the polyhedron based on the properties of linear objective functions on graphs. The applicability of the horizontal method to the general configuration of permutations is substantiated. The proposed method for solving multiobjective combinatorial problems belongs to the group of branch and bound methods.

articleTitle: Detecting and Handling Flawed Input Data in Modified Morphological Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The techniques and procedures for handling uncertainties, namely incompleteness and contradictoriness, in input information for modified morphological analysis method are proposed and discussed. Incompleteness is considered both for input estimates of the alternatives, and for a set of alternatives of a given parameter. An approach for detecting parameters having a potentially incomplete set of alternatives is proposed, as well as a technique for assigning an estimate to auxiliary filler alternatives designed for fixing this gaps. A procedure for assessing contradictoriness of cross-consistency matrix values is also introduced and tested on an example of a previous morphological study.

articleTitle: New Classes of Unconstrained Permutation-Based Problems and Their Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Three permutation-based matrix combinatorial sets were introduced: a) a matrix set of multipermutations of row entries; b) a matrix set of permutations of rows; c) a matrix set of multipermutations of rows and row entries. A polynomial (on the dimension of matrices) solvability of linear combinatorial optimization problems on these sets was justified. The connection between these problems with Linear Assignment Problems is established. Thus a class of polynomially solvable optimization problems is expanded remarkably. These results can be applied in different areas of Operations Research, such as Geometric Design and optimal management.

articleTitle: Strategy of Economic Development: a Proposal for Ukraine upon Econometrics of Geometry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: This article shows a methodology of a system analysis for providing the foresight of a strategy for Ukraine’s economic development. A linear equation is set to simulate how the gross domestic product (GDP) of Ukraine can be produced by various industrial sectors such as manufacturers, energy, food, tourism and small business. The effectiveness of the monetary donations from foreign countries is also taken into account for the simulation. The algorithm of the simulation is set in a geometry with a multi-dimensional flat space of the variables, which represent those industrial sectors as well as the GDP. Actual data is used for the simulation, which is obtained between 1991 and 2019. Matrix algebra calculates the coefficients of a linear equation that simulates and determines strong and weak points of Ukraine’s industrial structure. The result of the simulation shows that Ukraine’s GDP has been heavily dependent on the monetary aid from foreign countries. Then a comparison is made with the simulation of the USA. As a result, it is found that Ukraine needs to promote exports. Upon this finding, a further study is made on a possibility for developing food export as an example. At the end, a discussion is shown on the existing problems of the export businesses.

articleTitle: Decision-Making Model on Potential Borrower Lending for Independent Experts Group
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: An original approach is being developed to formalize the process of making a collegial decision on a potential borrower lending. The approach is based on integration of independent experts individual decisions sorting the borrowers into three classes: trustworthy (able to repay a loan on time), conditionally trustworthy (may need a loan restructuring subsequently), unreliable (default is possible). The collective decision-making model is based on the Bayesian strategy and allows making a coordinated group decision even though the individual experts decisions may differ. Interval generalization of models is being proposed to ensure a collective decision minimum average risk on a set of emerging situations with a given confidence probability.

articleTitle: Investigations of Different Classes Hybrid Deep Learning Networks and Analysis of Their Efficiency in Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Investigations of hybrid GMDH neuro-fuzzy networks and neo-fuzzy networks in the problem of forecasting in the financial sphere were carried out. The problem of forecasting NASDAQ stock prices with an interval of 1 day, 1 week and month was considered In the process of forecasting the hyperparameters of hybrid fuzzy neural networks were optimized, namely the number of inputs, the number of rules and the size of the sliding window. Optimal structures of hybrid fuzzy neural networks for different prediction intervals were synthesized. Experimental studies of the efficiency of forecasting hybrid neo-fuzzy and neuro-fuzzy networks were carried out and compared with conventional DL networks according to MAPE criterion. Training time of hybrid DL networks was estimated and compared.

articleTitle: Extracting and Identifying Relationships of Key Phrases in Information Flows
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a linguistic-statistical method for an automatic extraction and identification relationships of key phrases in information flows in order to further identification narratives as a generalization of a set of such phrases. Means of detecting stable phrases are based on the concepts of machine learning, linguistic analysis and statistical calculations. Next, using modern methods of network analysis, the relationships of key phrases are researched, and their individual clusters that probably correspond to the narratives will be identified. A form of visual display of information flow in terms of key phrases and dates is proposed. This form is a Phraseme Diagram (Ph-Di), the cells of which are filled with numerical values corresponding to the frequencies of key phrases in relation to the dates on which they appear. This approach can be used to address the analysis and visualization of the distribution of narratives for any selected information flows in terms of issues of researcher interest and have a fairly significant time frame.

articleTitle: Transitive Transfer Learning for Lungs CT Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: This paper studies the effect of transitive transfer learning (TTL) in the medical image processing field on the practical task of tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis. A series of experiments on semantic segmentation of nodules on lung CT images based on ImageNet, LIDC-IDRI and a private dataset with pulmonary tuberculosis of tuberculoma type were performed. The LIDC-IDRI dataset was selected as a transitive one among other datasets based on the Optimal Transport Dataset Distance (OTDD) metric. The TTL with LIDC-IDRI dataset in this case is designed to reduce the distribution gap between the ImageNet dataset and the private TB dataset. DeepLabV3+ was used for the experiments. The following approaches based on this network were compared: training the network on a private dataset from scratch, training the network on a private dataset using ImageNet dataset weights, pre-training the network on a LIDC-IDRI dataset using ImageNet weights, with post-training on a private tuberculosis dataset. In this way, the effectiveness of conventional deep learning, transfer learning, and transitive transfer learning approaches in the popular lung CT image domain is compared. Experiments have shown that using transitive transfer learning with the LIDC-IDRI dataset effectively bridges the distributional gap between the ImageNet source domain and the target domain of the private tuberculosis dataset. The accuracy increments for mIoU, F1 and F2 score were 0.1622, 0.1577 and 0.1645, respectively. The obtained results proved the efficiency of TTL with dataset selection based on OTDD in the task of segmentation of CT lung images on private practical datasets.

articleTitle: Solving Optimal Control Problems on Finite and Infinite Intervals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: When modeling many natural problems, it is necessary to deal with the control of processes that are subject to extreme instantaneous influences of a pulsed nature, which leads to complex nonlinear behavior of the object of study. The problems of optimal control of pulse systems, in the study of which the averaging method is used, are studied. This approach allows to obtain conditions that provide predictability and controllability of a dynamic system with impulse influence at both finite and infinite time interval.

articleTitle: Studying Cyclicity in Small Economic System Using Imitational Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: In this article the problem of modeling a small economic system using simulation modeling was considered. Thus, the problem of cycles is one of the fundamental issues of both macro and microeconomic science. The study of causes of cycles, as well as their modeling allows us to understand more about the system itself, the relationship between agents in it, as well as about the nature of the processes that occur in it. Thus, the best way for this kind of analysis is the tool of imitational modeling, which allows to study the system on the dealt level and represent systems of high complexity and hierarchical structure. The model under consideration is a simple illustration of a possible cause of cycles and may be further improved by the use of various means. One of the main tasks of this work is to build an example of using the modeling of the category of information in an applied model and to characterize possible further development. The main goal is to determine further directions of development in this topic, namely the presentation of information as a permanent and significant economic factor along with the classical determinants of economic models.

articleTitle: Comparison Analysis of Prioritization Quality Criteria Using Paired Comparison Method of Prioritization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is one of the most widely applied multicriteria methods for solving many real-world decision-making problems, including the prioritization. The paper deals with the pairwise comparison method - one of the main components of AHP for computing weights of decision alternatives with respect to a single decision factor, criterion or a goal. The evaluation is often made by an expert under uncertainty, ambiguity and indeterminacy. Therefore, many interval and fuzzy pairwise methods were proposed. In this paper, a problem of choosing the best method is considered. Four criteria are considered, which can be used to evaluate the accuracy of pairwise methods for interval weights calculation. The comparison analysis of these criteria is performed based on computer modeling of synthetic sets of acceptable interval multiplicative preference relations with a wide range of inconsistency and indeterminacy level. The analysis involves computation of the criteria values depending on inconsistency and indeterminacy of interval multiplicative preference relations. Some interesting features of the considered criteria were revealed.

articleTitle: Short-term Solar Power Generation Forecasting for Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Nowadays, the world's energy consumption is growing, and solving the problem of replacing traditional sources with alternative ones is urgent. The solution to this problem is impossible without prior data analysis and further forecasting of energy production from alternative sources. However, the use of alternative energy sources in the wholesale electricity and power market is impossible without the implementation of short-term forecasting models for the day ahead. In this article, the authors briefly analyze the existing methods of short-term forecasting, which are used in forecasting power generation by solar power plants. Currently, there are already a large number of short-term forecasting models, and they all differ in their characteristics. Therefore, in order to highlight the most promising for further use and short-term forecasting models development, the authors analyzed existing forecasting methods in the energy domain. During the study, the primary processing of the initial data obtained from existing solar power plants was performed using spectral analysis. Next, to build a prognostic model, a correlation analysis of the primary data was performed, which showed the absence of a linear relationship between the retrospective data components. The authors, based on the indications of correlation analysis, decided to select parameters for the construction of a prognostic model empirically. As a result of the study, a mathematical model based on an artificial neural network was proposed and a training sample was formed. The architecture of the artificial neural network was determined, the result of which is a short-term power generation forecast from solar panel.

articleTitle: Qualitative Analysis of Equations Perturbed by Random Processes of "White Noise"
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The report investigates the conditions of existence and the general appearance of locally invariant curves of a perturbed differential equation by a random Wiener process of the “white noise” type in the form of Ito. Random perturbations occur along the phase velocity vector of the corresponding undisturbed differential (deterministic) equation. The conditions under which the locally phase trajectories of the corresponding deterministic differential equation can be locally invariant curves of the perturbed equation are established. A model example describing a certain class of problems related to the study of random harmonic oscillators is given. The conducted researches in an example illustrate application of the received results for construction and the analysis of stochastic differential equations of Ito. The proposed results can be used for qualitative analysis of random harmonic oscillators.

articleTitle: Modeling the Management of Objects with Complex Formalized Information
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Intensive informatization of society leads to the widespread introduction of information technology in the field of socio-economic systems. Modern information systems, as a rule, use expert knowledge accumulated in various fields of human activity, which leads to uncertainties of different kinds. Fuzzy logic allows the extensive use of expert knowledge. Building decision-making models for problems with poorly formalized information is possible through the use of fuzzy set theory and building fuzzy logic systems. The paper describes and substantiates the use of the fuzzy second order sets, as the introduction of fuzzyness into the membership function allows us to bring the fuzzy model closer to human thinking and perception.

articleTitle: Application of the Continuous Fourier Transformation in Signal Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: There are a number of methods in systems analysis that are used to solve a wide range of applied problems, including digital signal processing. The method of discrete Fourier transformation is one of the widely used methods. The method of discrete Fourier transformation allows us to analyze, convert and synthesize signals. It is not possible using analog processing. The discrete Fourier transformation is particularly used to work with digital signals processing. However, sometimes it is necessary to work with continuous signals, so it is impossible to use the Fourier discrete transformation. In such cases, we use the so-called continuous Fourier transformation, which is a continuous analogue of a discrete transformation and has a similar content. Due to the specifics of the continuous Fourier transformation as a method for solving classical problems of systems analysis, there is a need to study the number of its properties, including its convergence. The relation between the smoothness of the summing Abel-Poisson function, which models the studied signal, and the convergence rate of its continuous Fourier transformation has been established. Since the summing Abel-Poisson functions are harmonic, as well as the signals that occur in real conditions, the results obtained in this paper take into account not only the smoothness of the function, but also its periodicity. Having taken into account this aspect, we could indicate the method of signal recovery, which gives better approximate properties than those previously studied in foreign and domestic scientific works.

articleTitle: The Model of Diffusion Processes in a Two-Phase Strip with Randomly Disposed Spherical Inclusions near the Mass Source on the Body Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: In the work the mathematical model and method of system analysis for the qualitative and quantitative description of compound systems with random structure is proposed. The proposed scheme of investigation is applied for description of the diffusion process in two-phase strip with randomly disposed spherical inclusions concentrated near the body surface where the constant mass source acts.

articleTitle: Kepler’s Data Mining and Calendar Reform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: On Kepler’s first law basis, a simple mathematical model of the Earth's orbit annual cycle is proposed, the seven-day week is astronomically substantiated, and the Keplerian calendar is introduced. Based on this data, it becomes possible to stabilize the Gregorian calendar, making it more convenient for planning as a result.

articleTitle: Choosing MIRT Model for Analysis of Quality of Pedagogical and Psychological Tests
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: We compare compensatory and noncompensatory MIRT (Multidimensional Item Response Theory) models in application to analysis of mathematical and psychological tests. The base model we consider is the multidimensional 2-PL model, and the analyzed data are results of probability theory exams conducted at National Technical University of Ukraine. All computations are performed using R statistical software. The dimensionality of the model is determined using Empirical Kaiser Criterion. The comparison of compensatory and noncompensatory models is conducted using special information criteria.

articleTitle: The Model of Additive Manufacturing Business-Ecosystem in the Conditions of War in Europe
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: In order for the economy to continue to develop during the war, it is important to produce consolidated technological products with individual characteristics that can be used for defence purposes. In such harsh conditions, one of the best solutions is the development of additive manufacturing (AM) or 3D printing technology. Revolutionary or evolutionary, 3D printing technology is recognized as an important trend that will significantly affect supply chains. The purpose of this study is to explore the main issues related to the use of 3D printing technology in the military sphere, and the possibility of changing the defence supply chain. The study analyses the conceptual mechanism of additive production for state defence, its characteristics and specific features, identifies the main problems of introducing additive technologies in the defence sphere and develops a model of additive production business-ecosystem for the defence in wartime.

articleTitle: Interpretation Method for Dynamic States Neural Network Models
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The work is devoted to the problem of interpretation the dynamic states neural network models. The apparatus of time delay neural networks is considered for modelling dynamic states of research object. The aim of the work is to develop a method for interpreting dynamic state models in the form of neural networks, providing high accuracy of the interpreting models construction. This aim is achieved by applying the integral nonparametric dynamic models based on multidimensional weight functions. The most significant results consist in obtaining the method of interpretation the dynamic states neural network models with preservation of nonlinear and dynamic properties of the research object. Significance of the obtained results: the application of the proposed method allows both high accuracy and efficiency of the construction interpreting models, allows providing modelling of the nonlinear dynamic states objects that are in a functional mode. The proposed method was verified using the data of the test nonlinear dynamical object. The verification results demonstrates high accuracy and efficiency of the construction of interpreting models.

articleTitle: Signals Recovery by Means of Three-Harmonic Equations Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: An intensive development of signal theory has been taking place for the last decades. Therefore, the range of such problems has expanded considerably. Problems closely related to the mathematical methods have become especially important. We can include here problems related to image processing, filtering audio and other signals, etc. It should be noted that these problems are often related to the methods of systems analysis and approximation theory. In particular, in many digital signal processing problems, interpolation is one of the classic methods of their solution. When we talk about the usage of interpolation polynomials in signal theory, we are used to using standard methods of spline-type interpolation, Lagrange interpolation polynomials or Hermite polynomials. However, signals are known to be approximated the best by periodic functions. Trigonometric analogues of Lagrange interpolation polynomials are the standard examples of interpolation that could be used in practice. But such methods do not always give good results or are not easy to use. To solve this problem, we should keep in mind that signals are harmonic functions. Therefore, the discrete Fourier transformation has been used in many scientific works. However, this approach does not always give the desired effect, so the question of constructing alternative interpolation polynomials arises. In this paper, we propose a new approach to signal recovery, which allows getting better signal recovery than that given by the most common methods of signal recovery. The usage of interpolation polynomials proposed in this paper provides an improvement in signal recovery compared to their classical counterparts.

articleTitle: Synchronization of Business Cycles of Ukraine and Its Neighbor Countries
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to synchronization between business cycles of Ukraine and its neighbor countries (Poland, Hungary, Slovak Republic, Romania, Belarus and Russia) in 2010-2020. Authors have used factor analysis model to study which of the Ukrainian neighbor countries is more synchronized with economy of Ukraine. Factor analysis research methodology has been divided into four stages: data collection and compilation of correlation matrix, removal of orthogonal factors or factorization with principal component analysis, factor rotation with Varimax rotation method using Kaiser normalization and data interpretation. Results of the study contribute to the general idea about geographical proximity as a factor fostering business cycles synchronization. The research has revealed similar dispersion of variables between factors of Ukraine, Poland and Hungary. The study has shown that in 2010-2020 business cycles of Ukraine were more synchronized with economic cycles of its western neighbors (Poland and Hungary) comparing to those of Russia and Belarus. The study has also revealed that Ukraine and Poland have similar trade component of analysis that can contribute to the thesis concerning trade impact on business cycles synchronization.

articleTitle: Computer Complex for Modeling Nonlinear Hyperbolic Equations of Second Order
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The tool for numerical solution for the nonlinear partial differential equations of second order in space and time had been decribed. The explicit and implicit difference schemes had been realized in proposed computer software. Recent computer tools: Python, matplotlib, plotLayerOfU, Python cPickle. The examples of using proposed tool for concrete equations are described. One of such example is nonlinear Burgers equation of hyperbolic type.

articleTitle: On Large Deviations for the Solutions of Stochastic Programming Problems with Continuous Parameter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Stochastic programming problems with continuous parameter are considered. The empirical function is constructed by the observations of random processes. Stationary and no stationary observations are investigated. Large deviations of the solutions are estimated.

articleTitle: Investigation of Bifurcation Transitions to Deterministic Chaos in Nonlinear Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: In this paper, based on multi-parameter analysis, we present the results of a numerical study of the types of bifurcation sequences in which a nonlinear dynamic system switches to a chaotic regime. The Y. S. Chen system was chosen as the object of study. Such patterns of bifurcation sequences (scenarios) as Feigenbaum, type-I Pomeau-Manneville, Ruelle-Takens-Newhouse, universal intermittency of the type “chaotic attractor of one type - chaotic attractor of another type” are identified and investigated. The values of the Poincare-Andronov-Hopf bifurcations are calculated exactly. The existence of quasi-periodic dynamics of the system and its transition to deterministic chaos by means of Neimark-Sacker bifurcations are shown.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Effectiveness of Information Technology Methods for Processing Diagnostic Information Based on Complex Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The developed models were tested for adequacy and the effectiveness of information technology methods for processing diagnostic information based on complex data was evaluated. The obtained indicators of informativeness of diagnostic tools showed high values of sensitivity, specificity and accuracy, the latest coincides with the actual one by no less than 94.39. A control study of the effectiveness of the methods showed that it was possible to reduce the time spent on diagnosis by at least 8.97%.

articleTitle: Stochastic Automata and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: In this paper we consider the role of hidden Markov models (HMM) in speech recognition and analyze its benefits and disadvantages in this process. We compare it with multilayer perceptron networks (MPNs) and consider also the hybrid model, which includes both of them.

articleTitle: Some Applied Aspects of Zygmund Function Classes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Working with signals we take into account their belonging to a certain class of signals. This belonging is given by the certain characteristic or set of characteristics peculiar for signals of this class. For most systems analysis problems related to signal theory, the question of their mathematical modeling arises. In such problems, the studied signal must be described by the certain function. Some characteristics of the signal correspond to certain properties of the function that this signal describes. This allows us to study the required signal characteristics as properties of a class of functions. Among the various classes of functions of systems analysis, Zygmund functions classes are the most popular from the practical point of view. When studying signals, we can describe them in the form of solutions of differential equations. This method of representation is very important in practice, as it helps to study the valuable signals properties from the practical point of view and helps to build certain approximations of the function that these signals model. In this paper, we have investigated the possibilities of approximation of the function from Zygmund class describing the signal by means of solutions of some second order differential equations in partial derivatives. The degree of signals approximation by solutions of biharmonic equations under certain boundary conditions has been obtained. A comparative analysis of the obtained degree of approximation at different values of the parameters characterizing Zygmund class has been made.

articleTitle: A Statistical Technique to Construct Data-Driven Decision Rules Based on Prediction Intervals of Nonlinear Regressions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: A statistical technique to build data-driven decision rules based on prediction intervals of nonlinear regressions created using multivariate normalizing transformations is proposed. In the general case, the proposed technique is iterative since there may be outliers in the process of building the decision-making rule based on prediction intervals of nonlinear regression. To construct nonlinear regressions and their prediction intervals we use the appropriate techniques based on multivariate normalizing transformations that take into account the correlation between dependent and independent variables. We give examples of constructing data-driven decision rules based on prediction intervals of nonlinear regression with two predictors created using the Johnson three-variate normalizing transformation for the S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</inf> family for three-dimensional non-Gaussian data from 33 auto companies, 32 of which were from the S&P 500 Index in 2020. The above rules are constructed to make a decision in which stocks it is better to invest in. We have found that as of December 2020, the shares of two auto companies were overvalued, and the shares of one, on the contrary, were undervalued, so the shares of this company could be bought.

articleTitle: O-glycosylation Site Prediction Using Randome Forest Importance and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Due to the significant roles of O-glycosylation in the biological processes as well as its association with various human diseases, in this work we propose a machine learning model to improve O-glycosylation site prediction from the protein sequences. Different types of sequence-based feature extraction methods were used to encode the peptide sequences. Consequently, random forest importance and incremental feature selection techniques are implemented to select small informative features. Then, the support vector machine (SVM) method was used for classification and prediction. In terms of accuracy, AUC, sensitivity, specificity, and MCC metrics, the proposed model outperformed the other machine learning techniques and the existing tools.

articleTitle: Solving the Problem of Convergence of the Results of Analog Signals Conversion in the Process of Aircraft Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The development of robotic systems, artificial intelligence systems, and information technology is changing the paradigm of search management for both moving and stationary objects (targets). The task of finding targets in a given limited space is not new and is solved by performing monitoring tasks, search and rescue operations, assessing the state of critical infrastructure, and planning and performing special tasks. The task is complicated by the need to organize group search, coordinate between groups, search autonomy by eliminating the role of the operator, and the introduction of elements of the artificial element. The presented research has shown the efficiency of the use of cellular automatic machines for the decision of problems of search of a route at the search of the purposes in various conditions. Improving the efficiency of the cellular automaton is achieved by clustering search objects and bypassing targets in the cluster. This reduces the number of search steps. The proposed approach to the implementation of cellular automata will create an effective system for monitoring the condition of observation objects, which will minimize the number and composition of monitoring groups.

articleTitle: Biological-Social Expediency, Information Causality and Conceptual Spaces in Neural Networks of the Brain: Approach to Building of Artificial Intelligence Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: This article is devoted to the problem of identifying the conditions and mechanism under which the neural networks of the brain of living beings, being physical entities, operate information precisely biologically and/or socially expediently. We try to show that the functional (causal) inclusion of psychic (mental) factor of subjective value in the information activity of the brain neural networks explains why, at each moment of information processing, specific hierarchical relationships arise, allowing the exchange of information between control and controlled networks in the bottom-up and top-down direction. The first one delivers information “to the top” for its integration. The second one provides a control flow of information “to the bottom”, formed on the basis of already integrated information. To demonstrate the dependence on the biological or/and social expediency of the information activity of neural networks of the brain on the implementation of mental phenomena in them, a special scheme is used. It is emphasized that without taking into account psychic phenomena it is impossible to explain how the information in the neural networks of the brain becomes a causal factor. In addition, it is shown that this approach can be useful in applied research involved in the development of human-like AI systems. We propose to consider conceptual spaces for modeling the subjective evaluation and thus integration of information.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Analysis of Bifurcatory Properties of Mathematical Model of Subpopulation Dynamics in the Case of a Single Niche for Subpopulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The article is devoted to the use of mathematical models of the dynamics of heterogeneous populations, and computer simulation based on the above models allows to identify general trends in subpopulations, predict the state of the system and obtain results on possible consequences of artificial intervention. Also, the use of mathematical models can predict the spread of genetic anomalies. The authors propose a model of subpopulation dynamics with a logistic function as a basic one. It is concluded that the system-wide dynamics of subpopulation processes depends not only on the reproductive potential of subpopulations, but also on the intrasystemic dynamics that objectively occur in such systems. The adequacy of the proposed mathematical model is proved.

articleTitle: Economical and Mathematical Methods of Project Management
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: This work is devoted to project management team formation. Different approaches are considered. The main characteristics of the team are determined. The work provides qualifications for a number of team members. Depending on the modelling apparatus used, several areas of research have been identified. For the purpose of comparative analysis and team members selection for the same competence, it is necessary to calculate the integrated indicator. The main methods of evaluation and comparison of multi-criteria alternatives are considered: multi-criteria utility theory MAUT (Multi-Attribute Utility Theory), analytical hierarchy (AIR), and quality advantage relations (ELECTRE). An example of the implementation of the MAUT method is given. Let's consider multicriteria tasks on executors' appointment for the basic project works within the limits of dynamic partnership activity. An example of optimization according to three criteria: cost, executor competence, and task execution time is given.

articleTitle: Checking the Regularity of the Linear Method of Summation Fourier Series
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Systems analysis is a powerful tool for studying complex systems of various natures. Periodic signals can be represented by orthogonal systems of functions. Examples of such orthogonal systems are Walsh system, Chebyshev system and others. The system of trigonometric functions of sines and cosines of multiple arguments has become the most widespread. But, as we know, there are examples of continuous functions, the Fourier series of which diverge at some points. Series summation methods make it possible to match a divergent series to some ”sum”. An example of a matrix with convenient elements for checking the necessary and sufficient conditions for the regularity of the rectangular summation method is given.

articleTitle: Matrix Neural Network with Kernel Activation Function and Its Online Combined Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: In the paper, we introduce a matrix neural network with a kernel activation function that is meant to process information in real-time mode. The distinctive feature of the system is during learning not only synaptic weights but also the architecture of the system tunes. At the same time, there are such criteria to be minimized as mean square error and empirical risk one. The proposed system combines the advantages of support vector machines, probabilistic neural networks, and radial basis function networks that allow tuning the proposed system under conditions of a small training dataset.

articleTitle: Estimation of SIRM Model’s Nonstationary Parameters of COVID-19 in Czech Rebuplic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: This paper is a comprehensive study dedicated to practical solution of estimation problems in models of the spread of infectious diseases. Mentioned algorithms of parameters’ estimation make possible to build mathematical models of the spread of infectious diseases based on observations. The results of analysis of the approach to mathematical modeling of the spread of infectious diseases are given in this paper, in particular simulation models and estimation methods in models of population dynamics. Computer simulation for analysis of COVID-19 pandemic in Czech Republic demonstrates efficiency o f t he mentioned algorithm.

articleTitle: Tools for Digitalization of Public and Economic Services
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The article considers the technology of creating tools to support digitalization tasks to perform complex computational scenarios based on service-oriented (microservice) architecture in a cloud environment.

articleTitle: Intersubjective Paradigm and Oracle Conceptualization as an Open-Closed Platform for Programming Technologicalization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The paper examines the role of the intersubjective paradigm and oracle conceptualization as an open-closed platform for programming technology. The closed part is a technological environment of programming, a kind of logical abstraction of all the variety of technical programming systems that is consistent. The basis of such a platform is intersubjective logic. The open part is the carrier of possible subject technological systems of programming focused on the subject. It is shown that the technological environment of programming is explicitly reduced to coexistent assimilations, with subsequent reduction to oracle schemes, and as a consequence to composites and compositions. Based on the consideration the technological system of programming based on primitive program algebra is analyzed.

articleTitle: Results of Approbation of the Method for Predicting the Classification Accuracy of Multichannel Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The results of verification of the method for predicting the classification accuracy for three-channel remote sensing images are presented. This study is carried out based on pixel-by-pixel classification according to the maximum likelihood criterion. As a criterion for classification accuracy, the weighted total probability of correct recognition of classes is taken, where the weight coefficients are a priori probabilities of the occurrence of objects from the corresponding classes. The results of comparison of statistical estimates of a priori probabilities of classes and their predictions by the Monte Carlo method using “hard” and fuzzy classification are presented. Empirical dependences of the relative errors of prediction of the probabilities of correct recognition on the sample size are obtained. It is shown that predictions of the total probability of correct recognition, provided that the random sample is representative and of sufficient volume, produce the specified reliability. At the same time, the volume of processed data is significantly (at least by 1-2 orders of magnitude) reduced. This, in turn, leads to the corresponding reduction in the complexity of calculations and the time spent on obtaining predictions for the desired criteria.

articleTitle: Fractal Analysis in Urban Studies: A Case Study on Ukrainian cities
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The paper provides a survey of the fractal theory, focusing on applications to the study of cities. Cities are especially interesting because they can be considered fractal systems with self-affinity or self-similarity, and their spatial structures are often subject to scale invariance and have self-similarity. The article gives the main definitions and describes commonly used algorithms for calculating the fractal dimension. In three case studies, fractal properties of 11 Ukrainian cities are analyzed. First, their “fractality” is confirmed by ht-index calculation for many object types in cities, like road networks, buildings, boundaries, land use, and natural objects. Second, the fractal dimensions of the road networks and buildings are calculated. Third, this paper illustrates how the fractal dimension varies over different parts of Kyiv.

articleTitle: Influence of the Digital Economy on the Innovative Development of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The article considers the dependence of innovative development of the enterprise on the growth of the digital economy. The issue of digitalization coverage of the main activities of enterprises is revealed, noting hat the digital economy is based on innovation with the use in production, promotion, sale, delivery of goods and services of Industry 4.0 technologies. The concept of digital infrastructure as technologies, products and services, hardware and software resources that provide the ability to connect, interact and operate modern digital technologies, use information and data in full. The positions of Ukraine in the world innovation and digital rankings are analyzed, indicating positive and negative tendencies of introduction of digitalization in the activity of enterprises. To determine Ukraine’s position in the world innovation and digital rankins the following indeces were used as a benchmark: Network Readiness Index; ICT Development Index; Global Innovation Index, Digital Economy and Society Index; Global Competitiveness Index. Ukraine’s position in the Country-level digital competitiveness ranking is additionally analyzed. The three main components of the digital economy in the activities of enterprises are identified, namely the use of the Internet in the activities of enterprises, the use of Industry 4.0 technologies by Ukrainian enterprises, assessment of digital literacy of the Ukrainian population. The limit norm of replacement of constituent elements of digital economy in activity of the enterprise in an optimum point of its development is defined. According to the calculations, it was found that in the unsatisfactory state of one of the components of enterprise’s digital development, the replacement of such an element is possible by replacing the two elements in the existing business models. The main goal of the article is to model and determine the impact of the digital economy on the innovative development of enterprises based on the use of such indicators as the level of digital literacy of the population of Ukraine, the use of Industry 4.0 technologies by Ukrainian enterprises and use of modern means of the Internet in the activities of enterprises.

articleTitle: Modified Neural Network Method for Diagnostics the Helicopters Turboshaft Engines Operational Status at Flight Modes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The work is devoted to the improvement of the method for diagnostics aircraft engines operational status using neural networks, which, due to the use of a hybrid ensemble of neural networks as a neural network classifier, consisting of six radial-basic neural networks, Kohonen neural network neural network and hybrid neural network, as well as 14 thermogasdynamic parameters of the engine (of which three parameters are recorded on board of the helicopter, 11 parameters are determined analytically) and two flow rates (air consumption and fuel consumption), made it possible to diagnostics helicopter turbo shaft engines operational status in flight modes.

articleTitle: Financial Stability as a Factor of Ensuring Sustainable Development of Ukraine’s Economy in the Conditions of Globalization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The aggravation of the financial, economic, and political crisis in Ukraine, declining socio-economic development and increasing the destabilizing effects of shadowing and offshoring of the economy, increasing destructive phenomena and processes occurring in the national economy slow down socio-economic development and destructively affect the national economy. In this context, there is a particularly significant impact on the intensification of financial crime, which requires a rapid and effective response and search for countermeasures. This is evidenced by a significant increase in losses of the state budget due to non-receipt of tax revenues, which is associated with tax evasion, legalization of proceeds from crime (money laundering), fraud with financial resources. However, negative trends in financial crimes affect not only the state budget indicators but also other macroeconomic indicators, which raises the need to research this issue and address it immediately. The article identifies the features of ensuring the country’s financial stability, the nature of financial crimes and their impact on economic development, and outlines the main problems of combating financial crime in the system of combating money laundering. The article sheds light on the dynamics of financial crimes in Ukraine, the amount of legalized funds and property obtained by criminal means, and the amount of pure illegal financial flow outside Ukraine. The article assesses the dynamics of tax revenues to the state budget and losses due to tax evasion by economic entities, correlation and regression analysis of the impact of corruption, the shadow economy and shadow GDP on the amount of legalized (laundered) funds. The main methods and schemes of tax evasion are identified and the amounts of money associated with tax evasion are analyzed. The main measures to ensure financial stability as a factor of sustainable economic development in the context of strengthening globalization and European integration are proposed.

articleTitle: Concepts of Primary and Secondary Coherent Images in Radar and Optical Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Using the laws of ray optics and the laws of diffraction, the field in the registration area and the simplest definition of a coherent image of the surface are determined. In terms of the phenomenological approach, coherent images and the fields created by them in the registration area are described. According to the problems of radar and optics, the concepts of primary and secondary coherent images are substantiated. The concepts of primary basis functions, primary spread function, secondary basis function, and secondary spread function are introduced for solving inverse problems of restoring primary and secondary coherent images of underlying surfaces. Possible geometries of locations and sizes of the field registration areas and surface observation areas are shown in the development of mathematical procedures for the restoration of primary coherent images. The results of primary and secondary images of surfaces are shown on the example of a real radioholograms.

articleTitle: Intellectual Decision Support System for Modeling and Forecasting Nonlinear Nonstationary Financial Processes and Risks Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: This study shows a possibility for design and implementation of intellectual decision support system (IDSS) for solving the problems of modeling and forecasting nonlinear nonstationary processes (NNP) in finances and using the models for risk estimation. Such processes are met very often in practice and require special attention for performing their analysis; as an example, could be mentioned heteroscedastic processes. The practical methodology is proposed for development intellectual DSS aiming to provide substantial help in analyzing NNP and financial risks of various origin. The methodology includes detailed analysis of possible uncertainties inherent to financial data and the methods are highlighted to fight these uncertainties. The necessity is also stressed for applying several sets of statistical criteria providing for a high quality of intermediate and final results of modeling selected processes, forecasting their evolution and financial risk computing. Some possibilities for improving value-at-risk estimation are considered. Application of the IDSS proved its practical usability and effectiveness. Future improvements of the system are mentioned aiming to refinement of risk estimation and management procedures.

articleTitle: Problem-Oriented Model in Technical Specialized Applications of Transport Systems Management
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The article presents the results of a mathematical model development and analysis of brake disk and brakeblock thermal state during braking with consideration for influence of the design, materials science and operational factors, for which the loading-velocitudionous parameters of interaction of the disk brake members, the mutual overlap coefficient, the friction unit geometric pattern, physicomechanical and physicochemical characteristics of the properties of friction materials, as well as the parameters of microdeformations realizable in the contact area and in the contactless areas of the brake disk surface have been taken. It has been shown that the temperature fields of the brake disk working surface differ in the absolute, maximum values by 5-10% (for the entire braking time) and up to $10\ldots 15\%$ upon reaching a fixed time mark during braking with and without due regard for effect of the reversible deformations on the disk brake thermal state. It has been established that prediction of the generated and dissipated heat flux values during braking with consideration for influence of the reversible deformations makes it possible to improve the calculation adequacy up to 10-12%. The developed mathematical model adequacy has been assessed based on a comparison of the theoretical and empirical results obtained on a full-scale bench test set, the discrepancy of which does not exceed 20-25%.

articleTitle: Complex Research and Implementation of the IoT System for the Residential Buildings Vibroprotection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The territory of every city is a center of manmade dynamic loads caused by transport sources, construction and industrial equipment etc. Within a city the dynamic influences sources generate the vibrations with frequencies from 2-5 to 60-70 Hz, sometimes up to 200 Hz. The railway is a source of intense vibrations that cause impact on buildings and structures located near its lines. Under certain conditions the vibrations of the buildings foundations and structures may exceed the values permissible for their normal operation. The work aim is to substantiate the seismic and vibration protection system use for three sections of a residential complex (6, 10 and 13 floors) under the railway trains dynamic effects and seismic actions. To achieve this goal the following research works were performed: the experimental full-scale dynamic surveys of the soil surface at the construction site; the development of the spatial dynamic models of three sections; the sections calculations for dynamic influences of freight and passenger railway trains and seismic loadings with intensity of 6 points; the efficiency substantiation for the building vibroprotection system based on the results of calculations and check measurements of the floor slabs acceleration levels during the construction of three sections. The comparison of the experimentally recorded values of vibration acceleration levels and the permissible ones showed that under the influences of railway trains the soil vibration levels exceeded the permissible values by 6… 12 dB (i.e., from two to four times) for all three residential buildings. So, the necessity was confirmed to install a vibration system for protecting the pile grillage and basement walls, which would reduce the structures vibration levels and provide the comfortable living conditions in the residential complex.

articleTitle: Formation of Sustainable Development of Competitive Business in an Unstable Economy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Information about the features of sustainable development and its impact on the competitiveness of countries is given in the study. On the basis of economic and statistical methods, the degree of interconnection between the innovative activity of the leading countries and Ukraine, their economic development and the achievement of sustainable development goals is revealed. Substantiated recommendations on the formation of a model of sustainable development of countries in the conditions of Industry 4.0 in an unstable economy are proposed.

articleTitle: Development and Generalization of the Main Provisions of Equilibrium Thermodynamics Applied to General Quasi-Static Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: A method for mathematical modeling of multidimensional quasi-static processes, which are generalization of quasi-static processes in equilibrium thermodynamics, is proposed and substantiated. A generalization of the first and second law of thermodynamics in the form of Carathéodory for multidimensional quasi-static processes is obtained. The idea of generalization is the construction of an orthogonal system of functionals similar to the functionals of work and heat of classical thermodynamics along families of phase trajectories corresponding to different types of actions on a multidimensional quasi-static system. The representation of quasi-static processes by systems of ordinary differential equations containing control variables is substantiated. The obtained results make it possible to apply a wide arsenal of methods from the theory of dynamic systems control to solve problems of quasi-static processes control.

articleTitle: Phenomenological Assessment of the Link between the Economic Security Components of the Temporarily Occupied Donetskand Luhansk Regions, and Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Integral values of economic security of Donetsk and Lugansk regions in 2010-2019 were calculated (for 2012-2017 the integral index of economic security of the region decreased from 0,79 to 0,49 (by 0,30 p.p.)), while the decrease in the level of economic security of Donetsk region was not as steep (from 0,78 to 0,59 (by 0,19 p.p.). Using the author’s methodological approach, it is proved that the deterioration of the economic security parameters of Donetsk and Luhansk regions caused a decrease in the level of economic security of Ukraine. This is confirmed by the results of pairwise correlation analysis of the strength of the relationship between the components of economic security (the growth rate of component indices) of Lugansk and Lugansk regions and Ukraine (value of component indices), as well as the formation of multiple regression, where the dependent variable was the integral value of economic security of Ukraine, and independent - the growth rate of component indices of economic security of Donetsk and Lugansk regions. The formed equations of multiple regression show a high density of correlation and, respectively, the influence on Ukraine’s economic security of such components of the economic security of Lugansk region as macroeconomic (regression coefficient 0,08), food (0,41), investment and innovation (0,16) (direct impact) and demographic (minus 6,3) (reverse impact), the influence of such components of the economic security of Donetsk region as the financial (0,64), the production (0,64) and the foreign trade (0,47) (direct influence).

articleTitle: Heuristic Structures of Cognitive Aerospace Remote Sensing Radars
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: Cognitive radars are the most complex in structure and the most flexible radio engineering systems in terms of tasks to be solved. Much attention is paid to their construction and improvement because of their high potential. In this paper, it is proposed to apply the technology of cognitive dynamic systems to airborne synthetic aperture radars (SAR). An approach to optimizing the structure of onboard cognitive radars using the theory of nonlinear filtering is proposed. Heuristically, summarizing the experience of the authors in the synthesis of optimal algorithms for the functioning of onboard multichannel SAR and the existing results of optimization of tracking systems, several structures of onboard cognitive remote sensing radars are proposed.

articleTitle: Clusterization as a Factor of Business Development in Transport-Logistic Sphere
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The article is dedicated to the research into clusterization processes in economics as one of the factors of business development in transport-logistic sphere. The goal set by the authors was to analyse, systematise and summarise the existing theoretical principles and practical business experience concerning the defined science problem. The research was conducted using the two-staged approach. Firstly the impact of clusters formation and development on efficiency of separate spheres of national economic (on example of transport and logistics of Ukraine) has been studied on macro level by correlation analysis. Then the synergetic potential of the cluster has been described through using economic and mathematical modelling. The results of the research confirmed that the cluster is an effective organizational form of cooperation between government, business and science, which contributes to the simultaneous improvement of individual results of participating companies, the development of science, knowledge and innovation and sustainable economic development of the national economy. The recommendations according the development of Ukrainian transport-logistic system through formation transport-logistic clusters have been given.

articleTitle: Routing Method in Wireless IoT Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: The protocol for routing transmitted data in networks with mixed types of switching is considered, which is typical for sensor networks that are part of the IoT technology. A description of the methods and approaches used to improve the efficiency of using network bandwidth is proposed, and the results of comparative modeling of the effectiveness of the proposed and existing protocols are presented. This circumstance determines the relevance, scientific novelty and practical significance of research devoted to the development of new models, algorithms and software packages that allow solving this problem and suggesting new effective methods for routing and transmitting data in sensor wireless networks integrated into IoT.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Simulation for Cyber-Physical Systems on Electric Heater Example
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: A methodology of a digital twin modelling as a real physical object computer prototype, which is considered an electric heater, is proposed. The methodology allows to synthesize a discrete mathematical model due to the air heating process passive identification in an electric heater. The analysis of the electric heater mathematical model uncertain parameters is carried out and the integral quality indicator for the assessment of the dynamic model adequacy in the process of air heating is proposed. To adapt the electric heater dynamic model, the algorithm for passive identification of uncertain parameters has been developed, where the deviations of the model uncertain coefficients in the process of air heating are minimized. The examples show that the identification of the dynamic model uncertain coefficients should be classified as a one-extremes optimization problem. Numerical results confirmed the proposed methodology effectiveness for the modelling digital twin of electric heater for cyber-physical systems of industrial enterprises. The considered examples illustrate the proposed technique for modelling a digital twin using the applied modelling package MatLAB is an effective and convenient tool for the rational creation of cyber-physical systems.

articleTitle: Energy Freedom: Global Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 3rd International Conference on System Analysis & Intelligent Computing (SAIC)
abstract: A composite indicator that aggregates the quantitative values of the country’s energy system characteristics is proposed. The Energy Freedom Index is calculated for the period of 2000-2019. The results of clusterization for the group of 142 countries by the values of Energy Freedom Index are analyzed.
